parameters.query: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp"; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scheduled_followups (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), conversation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES conversaciones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, tipo_followup VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, scheduled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED')), processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, error_msg TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_followup_scheduled ON scheduled_followups(scheduled_at) WHERE status = 'PENDING'; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_followup_conv ON scheduled_followups(conversation_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_decisions (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), conversation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES conversaciones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, estado_entrada VARCHAR(50), mensaje_usuario TEXT, tokens_input INTEGER, intent VARCHAR(100), sentiment VARCHAR(20), confidence DECIMAL(4,3), next_state VARCHAR(50), trigger_handoff BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, trigger_loss BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, response_text TEXT, full_response JSONB, latencia_ms INTEGER, tokens_output INTEGER, model_used VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'gpt-4.1', is_fallback BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, error_msg TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_decisions_conv ON agent_decisions(conversation_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_decisions_created ON agent_decisions(created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_memory (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), conversation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES conversaciones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE UNIQUE, messages JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, nombre_confirmado VARCHAR(200), plan_mostrado_interes VARCHAR(100), objeciones JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, resumen_conversacion TEXT, nivel_interes VARCHAR(10), last_active_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_queue (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), conversation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES conversaciones(id), tipo_evento VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT', 'FAILED')), intentos INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ultimo_intento_at TIMESTAMPTZ, error_msg TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sync_queue_pending ON sync_queue(created_at) WHERE status = 'PENDING';

ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS variante_mensaje CHAR(1); ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS objeciones_detectadas JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS plan_interes VARCHAR(100); ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS razon_perdida VARCHAR(50); ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS estado_anterior VARCHAR(50); ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS estado_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(); ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS proxima_accion_at TIMESTAMPTZ; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS chatwoot_contact_id INTEGER; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS chatwoot_conv_id INTEGER; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS quicklink_sync_status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'PENDING'; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS quicklink_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS primera_respuesta_at TIMESTAMPTZ; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS latencia_primera_respuesta_ms INTEGER; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_mensajes_enviados INTEGER DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE conversaciones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_mensajes_recibidos INTEGER DEFAULT 0;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS configuracion_marcas (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), marca VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, nombre_servicio VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, activa BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true, max_intentos INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, timeout_espera_1_horas INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24, timeout_espera_2_horas INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24, timeout_espera_3_horas INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24, max_leads_por_minuto INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, prompt_contexto_marca TEXT, prompt_inicial_a TEXT, prompt_inicial_b TEXT, prompt_inicial_c TEXT, prompt_inicial_d TEXT, prompt_followup_2 TEXT, prompt_followup_3 TEXT, confidence_handoff_threshold DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0.80, confidence_loss_threshold DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0.75, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); INSERT INTO configuracion_marcas (marca, nombre_servicio) VALUES ('KIA', 'Telemetria KIA'), ('HYUNDAI', 'My Hyundai Link') ON CONFLICT (marca) DO UPDATE SET nombre_servicio = EXCLUDED.nombre_servicio, updated_at = now();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION trigger_set_updated_at() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $func$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $func$ LANGUAGE plpgsql; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS set_updated_at_conversaciones ON conversaciones; CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at_conversaciones BEFORE UPDATE ON conversaciones FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trigger_set_updated_at(); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION trigger_log_estado_cambio() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $func$ BEGIN IF OLD.estado IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.estado THEN INSERT INTO eventos_conversacion (conversation_id, tipo_evento, estado_origen, estado_destino, actor, payload) VALUES (NEW.id, 'estado_cambiado', OLD.estado, NEW.estado, 'sistema', jsonb_build_object('estado_anterior', OLD.estado, 'estado_nuevo', NEW.estado, 'ts', now())); NEW.estado_anterior = OLD.estado; NEW.estado_updated_at = now(); END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $func$ LANGUAGE plpgsql; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS log_estado_cambio ON conversaciones; CREATE TRIGGER log_estado_cambio BEFORE UPDATE ON conversaciones FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trigger_log_estado_cambio();

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_pipeline_actual AS SELECT marca, estado, COUNT(*) AS total FROM conversaciones GROUP BY marca, estado ORDER BY marca, total DESC; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_conversaciones_activas AS SELECT c.id, c.nombre, c.marca, c.modelo, c.telefono, c.estado, c.proxima_accion_at, sf.tipo_followup AS followup_pendiente, sf.scheduled_at AS followup_at, c.updated_at AS ultima_actividad FROM conversaciones c LEFT JOIN scheduled_followups sf ON sf.conversation_id = c.id AND sf.status = 'PENDING' WHERE c.estado NOT IN ('GANADO', 'OPORTUNIDAD_PERDIDA', 'NO_CONTACTABLE', 'DESCARTADO') ORDER BY c.proxima_accion_at ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduled_followups) as sf_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_decisions) as ad_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_memory) as cm_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_queue) as sq_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuracion_marcas) as config_rows, now()::text as migrated_at;
